content.content:
1	# zkregion
2	
3	面向区域成员关系的承诺与交互式证明原语。提供哈希承诺、素域乘法群上的 Schnorr 交互证明、确定性 SHA-256 Merkle 包含证明、量化区间的 Pedersen 陷门承诺及其上的 Schnorr OR 非交互区间证明、二维矩形区域成员非交互证明，以及量化整数坐标下的矩形区域判定。
4	
5	## 环境
6	
7	Python 3.10+，只依赖标准库（`hashlib`、`hmac`、`secrets`）。
8	
9	## 使用
10	
11	```python
12	from zkregion import Region, SchnorrProof, SchnorrProver, SchnorrVerifier, commit, verify_opening
13	
14	commitment, nonce = commit(b"coordinate")
15	assert verify_opening(commitment, b"coordinate", nonce)
16	
17	prover = SchnorrProver(secret=12345)
18	verifier = SchnorrVerifier(prover.public_key)
19	t = prover.new_commitment()
20	c = 987654321
21	s = prover.respond(c)
22	assert verifier.verify(t, c, s)
23	
24	# 非交互 Fiat-Shamir 证明
25	proof = prover.prove(b"payload", context=b"session-1")
26	assert verifier.verify_proof(b"payload", proof, context=b"session-1")
27	
28	# 同一公钥的批量验证
29	from zkregion import SchnorrBatchEntry
30	
31	batch = [
32	    SchnorrBatchEntry(b"alpha", prover.prove(b"alpha", context=b"s1"), context=b"s1"),
33	    SchnorrBatchEntry(b"beta", prover.prove(b"beta", context=b"s1"), context=b"s1"),
34	]
35	assert verifier.verify_batch(batch)
36	
37	# 多公钥 / 多群的批量验证（每个条目自带公钥与群参数）
38	from zkregion import MultiSchnorrEntry, verify_schnorr_batch
39	
40	other = SchnorrProver(secret=987654321)
41	multi = [
42	    MultiSchnorrEntry(prover.public_key, b"alpha", prover.prove(b"alpha", context=b"s1"), context=b"s1"),
43	    MultiSchnorrEntry(other.public_key, b"beta", other.prove(b"beta", context=b"s1"), b"s1"),
44	]
45	assert verify_schnorr_batch(multi)
46	
47	# Merkle 承诺的 Schnorr 完整批验：整批条目先提交到一棵 Merkle 树
48	from zkregion import BoundSchnorrBatch, merkle_root, prove_multi_inclusion, verify_bound
49	
50	def enc(value):
51	    return value.to_bytes(max(1, (value.bit_length() + 7) // 8), "big")
52	
53	def bound_leaf(entry):
54	    items = (
55	        b"zkregion/schnorr-fs/v1",
56	        enc(entry.prime), enc(entry.generator), enc(entry.public_key),
57	        enc(entry.proof.commitment), entry.context, entry.message,
58	        enc(entry.proof.response),
59	    )
60	    return b"".join(len(item).to_bytes(4, "big") + item for item in items)
61	
62	leaves = [bound_leaf(entry) for entry in multi]
63	root = merkle_root(leaves)
64	proof = prove_multi_inclusion(leaves, tuple(range(len(leaves))))
65	batch = BoundSchnorrBatch(tuple(multi), len(multi), proof)
66	assert verify_bound(batch, root)
67	
68	# Merkle 包含证明
69	from zkregion import prove_inclusion, verify_inclusion
70	
71	leaves = [b"alpha", b"beta", b"gamma"]
72	root = merkle_root(leaves)
73	inclusion = prove_inclusion(leaves, 1)
74	assert verify_inclusion(b"beta", inclusion, root)
75	
76	# Merkle 多包含证明（一次证明多片叶子，无需完整叶集即可验证）
77	from zkregion import verify_multi_inclusion
78	
79	multi = prove_multi_inclusion(leaves, (0, 2))
80	entries = [(0, b"alpha"), (2, b"gamma")]
81	assert verify_multi_inclusion(entries, multi, root)
82	
83	# Pedersen 陷门承诺：对区间 [lower, upper] 内的量化整数值做承诺
84	from zkregion import pedersen_commit, verify_pedersen_opening
85	
86	commitment, blinding = pedersen_commit(40, 0, 100)
87	assert verify_pedersen_opening(commitment, 40, blinding)
88	assert not verify_pedersen_opening(commitment, 41, blinding)
89	
90	# Pedersen 非交互区间证明（Schnorr OR）：证明承诺值落在声明区间内
91	from zkregion import prove_range, verify_range
92	
93	proof = prove_range(commitment, 40, blinding, context=b"session-1")
94	assert verify_range(commitment, proof, context=b"session-1")
95	assert not verify_range(commitment, proof, context=b"other")
96	
97	# 区间证明的批量验证（按 (prime, generator, h) 分组做随机线性组合）
98	from zkregion import RangeBatchEntry, verify_range_batch
99	
100	range_batch = [
101	    RangeBatchEntry(commitment, proof, b"session-1"),
102	    RangeBatchEntry(commitment, proof, b"session-1"),
103	]
104	assert verify_range_batch(range_batch)
105	
106	# 二维区域成员非交互证明：证明承诺的 (x, y) 落在矩形区域内
107	from zkregion import RegionProof, prove_region, verify_region
108	
109	region = Region(0, 100, 0, 100)
110	x_commitment, x_blinding = pedersen_commit(40, 0, 100)
111	y_commitment, y_blinding = pedersen_commit(60, 0, 100)
112	region_proof = prove_region(
113	    x_commitment, y_commitment, 40, 60, x_blinding, y_blinding, region, context=b"session-1"
114	)
115	assert verify_region(x_commitment, y_commitment, region, region_proof, context=b"session-1")
116	assert not verify_region(x_commitment, y_commitment, region, region_proof, context=b"other")
117	
118	# 二维区域证明的批量验证（按 (prime, generator, h) 分组做随机线性组合）
119	from zkregion import RegionBatchEntry, verify_region_batch
120	
121	batch = [
122	    RegionBatchEntry(x_commitment, y_commitment, region, region_proof, b"session-1"),
123	    RegionBatchEntry(x_commitment, y_commitment, region, region_proof, b"session-1"),
124	]
125	assert verify_region_batch(batch)
126	
127	# Merkle 承诺的区域证明完整批验：整批区域条目先提交到一棵 Merkle 树
128	from zkregion import BoundRegionBatch, verify_region_bound
129	
130	def bound_region_leaf(entry):
131	    items = [b"zkregion/region-bound/v1"]
132	    for c in (entry.x_commitment, entry.y_commitment):
133	        items += [str(v).encode("ascii")
134	                  for v in (c.element, c.lower, c.upper, c.prime, c.generator, c.h)]
135	    r = entry.region
136	    items += [str(v).encode("ascii") for v in (r.min_x, r.max_x, r.min_y, r.max_y)]
137	    items.append(entry.context)
138	    for sub in (entry.proof.x_proof, entry.proof.y_proof):
139	        for seq in (sub.t, sub.e, sub.s):
140	            items.append(str(len(seq)).encode("ascii"))
141	            items += [str(v).encode("ascii") for v in seq]
142	    return b"".join(len(item).to_bytes(4, "big") + item for item in items)
143	
144	region_leaves = [bound_region_leaf(entry) for entry in batch]
145	region_root = merkle_root(region_leaves)
146	region_proof = prove_multi_inclusion(region_leaves, tuple(range(len(region_leaves))))
147	bound_region = BoundRegionBatch(tuple(batch), len(batch), region_proof)
148	assert verify_region_bound(bound_region, region_root)
149	
150	Region(0, 100, 0, 100).contains(50, 50)     # True
151	```
152	
153	## 命令行演示
154	
155	```bash
156	python3 -m zkregion
157	```
158	
159	## 公开接口
160	
161	- `DEFAULT_PRIME` / `DEFAULT_GENERATOR` — 默认群参数（`2**127 - 1` 与 `3`）
162	- `commit(value, *, nonce=None) -> (commitment, nonce)` — 哈希承诺，`nonce` 缺省随机 16 字节
163	- `verify_opening(commitment, value, nonce) -> bool` — 常量时间比对
164	- `commit_coordinate(x, y, *, nonce=None)` — 对整数坐标对做承诺
165	- `pedersen_commit(value, lower, upper, *, prime=DEFAULT_PRIME, generator=DEFAULT_GENERATOR, h=None, blinding=None, randbelow=secrets.randbelow) -> (PedersenCommitment, blinding)` — 区间量化值的 Pedersen 承诺
166	- `verify_pedersen_opening(commitment, value, blinding) -> bool` — 复用承诺对象内参数验证开合
167	- `PedersenCommitment(element, lower, upper, prime, generator, h)` — 不可变承诺对象；承诺值为 `element = g**(value-lower) * h**blinding mod prime`
168	- `prove_range(commitment, value, blinding, context=b"", *, randbelow=secrets.randbelow) -> RangeProof` — 生成 Pedersen 承诺的非交互区间证明（Schnorr OR）
169	- `verify_range(commitment, proof, context=b"") -> bool` — 验证区间证明
170	- `RangeProof(t, e, s)` — 不可变区间证明对象，三个字段均为长度 `upper - lower + 1` 的 `tuple[int, ...]`
171	- `verify_range_batch(entries, *, randbelow=secrets.randbelow) -> bool` — 区间证明的批量验证，按 `(prime, generator, h)` 分组做一次随机线性组合
172	- `RangeBatchEntry(commitment, proof, context=b"")` — 不可变批量验证条目，字段类型依次为 `PedersenCommitment`、`RangeProof`、`bytes`，字段次序与 `verify_range` 入参一致
173	- `prove_region(x_commitment, y_commitment, x, y, x_blinding, y_blinding, region, context=b"", *, randbelow=secrets.randbelow) -> RegionProof` — 生成二维矩形区域成员非交互证明
174	- `verify_region(x_commitment, y_commitment, region, proof, context=b"") -> bool` — 验证区域成员证明，无需坐标或盲因子
175	- `RegionProof(x_proof, y_proof)` — 不可变区域证明对象，两字段均为 `RangeProof`
176	- `verify_region_batch(entries, *, randbelow=secrets.randbelow) -> bool` — 区域证明的批量验证，按 `(prime, generator, h)` 分组做一次随机线性组合
177	- `RegionBatchEntry(x_commitment, y_commitment, region, proof, context=b"")` — 不可变批量验证条目，字段次序与 `verify_region` 入参一致
178	- `SchnorrProver(secret, *, prime, generator, randbelow)`
179	  - `public_key` — `g**secret mod prime`
180	  - `new_commitment()` — 生成一次性随机数并返回 `g**k mod prime`
181	  - `respond(challenge)` — 返回 `k + challenge * secret`（不取模）
182	  - `prove(message, *, context=b"") -> SchnorrProof` — Fiat-Shamir 非交互证明
183	- `SchnorrVerifier(public_key, *, prime, generator)`
184	  - `verify(commitment, challenge, response)` — 交互式验证
185	  - `verify_proof(message, proof, *, context=b"") -> bool` — 非交互证明验证
186	  - `verify_batch(entries, *, randbelow=secrets.randbelow) -> bool` — 同一公钥的批量验证
187	- `SchnorrProof(commitment, response)` — 不可变证明对象（`t = g**k mod prime`，`s = k + c * secret`）
188	- `SchnorrBatchEntry(message, proof, context=b"")` — 不可变批量验证条目，字段类型依次为 `bytes`、`SchnorrProof`、`bytes`
189	- `verify_schnorr_batch(entries, *, randbelow=secrets.randbelow) -> bool` — 多公钥批量验证，按 `(prime, generator)` 分组做一次随机线性组合
190	- `MultiSchnorrEntry(public_key, message, proof, context=b"", prime=DEFAULT_PRIME, generator=DEFAULT_GENERATOR)` — 不可变多公钥批量验证条目；前三字段依次为 `int`、`bytes`、`SchnorrProof`，均为必填且可位置构造，值相等即相等
191	- `verify_bound(batch, root, *, randbelow=secrets.randbelow) -> bool` — Merkle 承诺的 Schnorr 完整批验：先 `verify_multi_inclusion` 验根，再以同一 `randbelow` 调 `verify_schnorr_batch` 验签
192	- `BoundSchnorrBatch(entries, leaf_count, proof)` — 冻结的完整批对象；字段依次为 `tuple[MultiSchnorrEntry, ...]`、正的非 `bool` `int`、`MerkleMultiProof`，均可位置构造、按值相等且不可变
193	- `verify_region_bound(batch, root, *, randbelow=secrets.randbelow) -> bool` — Merkle 承诺的区域证明完整批验：先 `verify_multi_inclusion` 验根，再以同一 `randbelow` 调 `verify_region_batch` 验子证明
194	- `BoundRegionBatch(entries, leaf_count, proof)` — 冻结的完整批对象；字段依次为 `tuple[RegionBatchEntry, ...]`、正的非 `bool` `int`、`MerkleMultiProof`，均可位置构造、按值相等且不可变
195	- `merkle_root(leaves) -> bytes` — 非空 `bytes` 序列的 Merkle 根
196	- `prove_inclusion(leaves, index) -> MerkleProof` — 按零基索引生成包含证明
197	- `verify_inclusion(leaf, proof, root) -> bool` — 验证包含证明
198	- `MerkleProof(index, siblings)` — 不可变证明对象，`siblings` 为按叶到根排列的 `tuple[bytes, ...]`
199	- `prove_multi_inclusion(leaves, indices) -> MerkleMultiProof` — 为多片叶子生成紧凑的合并包含证明
200	- `verify_multi_inclusion(entries, proof, root) -> bool` — 无需完整叶集验证多包含证明；`entries` 按 `proof.indices` 顺序给出 `(index, leaf)`
201	- `MerkleMultiProof(leaf_count, indices, siblings)` — 不可变多包含证明对象，`indices` 为 `tuple[int, ...]`，`siblings` 为 `tuple[bytes, ...]`
202	- `Region(min_x, max_x, min_y, max_y)` — 闭区间矩形；`contains(x, y)`
203	
204	### Merkle 树构造
205	
206	叶摘要为 `SHA-256(b"\x00" + len4 + leaf)`，其中 `len4` 是叶长的四字节无符号大端编码；内部节点摘要为 `SHA-256(b"\x01" + left + right)`。每层按输入顺序两两合并，奇数节点复制末项后再合并；单叶树的根就是叶摘要，证明路径为空。重复叶按调用方给出的零基索引定位，不按内容搜索。`leaves` 为空抛 `ValueError`，叶或索引类型错误抛 `TypeError`，索引越界抛 `IndexError`。验证时 `leaf`、`root` 与各兄弟摘要须为 `bytes`（后两者恰 32 字节），`proof` 须为 `MerkleProof` 且 `index` 为非负整数；类型错误抛 `TypeError`，摘要长度或索引结构非法返回 `False`。验证按 `index` 奇偶决定左右顺序并逐层整除二；叶、索引、路径或根被篡改均返回 `False`，所有入口均不改写输入。
207	
208	### Merkle 多包含证明
209	
210	多包含证明复用同一套哈希与奇数末项复制规则，把多片叶子的路径合并为一个证明。`indices` 须非空、严格递增且无重复；生成时逐层从左到右处理：兄弟节点本身也在被证明之列则直接合并、无需收集，奇数层末项无兄弟则自复制，其余情况才收集兄弟摘要；父层位置按 `position // 2` 去重。证明确定且最小——证明全部叶子时 `siblings` 为空。验证方只需 `entries`（按 `proof.indices` 顺序给出的 `(index, leaf)`）、证明与根，无需完整叶集；按同一规则逐层恢复根，且必须恰好耗尽全部 `siblings`，否则返回 `False`。
211	
212	生成时 `leaves` 须为非空 `bytes` 序列；`leaf_count` 须为正的非 bool 整数，索引须为范围内的非 bool 整数。类型错误抛 `TypeError`，`indices` 为空、重复或乱序抛 `ValueError`，越界抛 `IndexError`。验证时 `entries` 的索引序列须与 `proof.indices` 完全一致；`entries`、`proof`、`root` 或摘要的类型错误抛 `TypeError`；空项、乱序、越界、数量不符、摘要长度错误及任何篡改均返回 `False`。
213	
214	### Pedersen 量化坐标陷门承诺
215	
216	`pedersen_commit(value, lower, upper, ...)` 对声明在闭区间 `[lower, upper]` 内的量化整数值做 Pedersen 承诺：编码消息为偏移量 `m = value - lower`，承诺元素为
217	
218	```
219	element = g**m * h**r mod prime
220	```
221	
222	其中 `r` 为盲因子。`prime` 与 `g` 缺省取 `DEFAULT_PRIME` / `DEFAULT_GENERATOR`；`h` 缺省为 `g**2 mod prime`；盲因子缺省由 `randbelow(prime - 2) + 1` 生成（缺省源为 `secrets.randbelow`），也可用 `blinding=` 显式给出。函数返回 `(PedersenCommitment, blinding)`，承诺对象是冻结的 dataclass，携带 `element`、`lower`、`upper`、`prime`、`generator`、`h`，验证方无需其他带外参数。
223	
224	约束：必须有 `lower <= value <= upper`，且区间宽度 `upper - lower < prime - 1`；盲因子须在 `[1, prime - 1)`；`prime > 3`，`g` 与 `h` 均须位于 `(1, prime)`——无论 `h` 是显式传入还是按缺省 `g**2 mod prime` 计算，都会校验 `1 < h < prime`，不满足抛 `ValueError`。所有数值只接受非 `bool` 整数（`True`/`False` 不算整数）：`value`、边界、`prime`、`g`、`h`、`blinding` 类型错误抛 `TypeError`；`randbelow` 不可调用或其返回值不是整数抛 `TypeError`。非法区间、越界 `value`、非法群参数或盲因子越界抛 `ValueError`；`randbelow` 返回值超出 `[0, prime - 2)` 也抛 `ValueError`。
225	
226	`verify_pedersen_opening(commitment, value, blinding)` 只复用承诺对象内的群参数与区间，按同一公式重算并比对：`commitment` 不是 `PedersenCommitment` 或其字段、`value`、`blinding` 类型错误时抛 `TypeError`；对象内 `element` 或群参数越界、区间非法、`value` 越界、盲因子越界，或开合错误（错误的 `value`/`blinding`/`element`）一律返回 `False`。验证不改写任何输入。
227	
228	> **警告：默认 `h = g**2 mod prime` 的离散对数（`log_g(h) = 2`）是公开已知的，因此默认配置下的承诺不具备绑定性**——知道陷门即可对同一 `element` 给出多个开合（例如 `(value, r)` 与 `(value + 2, r - 1)`），演示程序会展示这一点。生产用途必须传入离散对数未知（无可信设置陷门）的 `h`。此外，单独的承诺对象只是带区间声明的承诺；"承诺值属于某区间" 的零知识论断由下文的 `prove_range` / `verify_range` 提供，且同样只是演示级安全强度。
229	
230	### Pedersen 非交互区间证明
231	
232	`prove_range(commitment, value, blinding, context=b"")` 在 Pedersen 承诺之上生成 Schnorr OR 风格的非交互区间证明，`verify_range(commitment, proof, context=b"")` 验证。对声明区间 `[lower, upper]` 内的每个偏移 `i`（共 `n = upper - lower + 1` 个，**最多 256 个整数**，超限生成抛 `ValueError`、验证返回 `False`）定义
233	
234	```
235	D_i = element * g**(-i) mod prime
236	```
237	
238	承诺以 `(value, r)` 开合当且仅当 `D_(value-lower) = h**r`，因此区间证明等价于"至少一个 `D_i` 以 `h` 为底的离散对数等于盲因子 `r`" 的 OR 证明。真实分支走诚实 Schnorr：取随机 `k`，`t = h**k mod prime`，挑战份额 `e = (c - Σ其他 e_i) mod prime`，响应 `s = k + e * r`（非负、不取模）；其余分支模拟：随机取 `e_i ∈ [0, prime)` 与非负 `s_i`，令 `t_i = h**s_i * D_i**(-e_i) mod prime`。证明为冻结的 `RangeProof(t, e, s)`，三个字段都是长度 `n` 的整数元组。
239	
240	挑战 `c` 为 SHA-256 摘要的大端整数模 `prime`。转录依次写入域 `b"zkregion/pedersen-range/v1"`、承诺六字段（`element`、`lower`、`upper`、`prime`、`generator`、`h`）、`context`、`n` 与全部 `t_i`；每项前置四字节无符号大端长度，整数编码为十进制 ASCII。
241	
242	验证要求：每个 `t_i ∈ [1, prime)`、`e_i ∈ [0, prime)`、`s_i ≥ 0`，`sum(e) mod prime == c`，且每个分支满足 Schnorr 等式 `h**s_i == t_i * D_i**e_i (mod prime)`。生成前会先复用 `verify_pedersen_opening` 校验开合，开合不符抛 `ValueError`；类型错误（含 `bool` 整数、非元组证明字段、非 `bytes` 的 `context`、不可调用的 `randbelow`）抛 `TypeError`；其他非法结构、篡改或绑定不符（错误的承诺、`context` 或证明）一律返回 `False`。入口均不改写输入。
243	
244	### 区间证明批量验证
245	
246	`verify_range_batch(entries, *, randbelow=secrets.randbelow)` 一次验证一批 `RangeProof`，每个条目就是 `verify_range` 的三个入参（`commitment`、`proof`、`context`，后者缺省 `b""`）冻结成的不可变数据类 `RangeBatchEntry`；字段类型依次为 `PedersenCommitment`、`RangeProof`、`bytes`。`entries` 须为非字符串、非空序列：空批返回 `False`，重复条目合法并各自独立取系数。漏项无法被发现，批次完整性由调用方保证。
247	
248	每个条目逐字节复用既定的 RangeProof 转录与结构校验：证明的 `t`/`e`/`s` 元组长度必须恰为承诺声明区间的整数数，逐个校验 `t_i ∈ [1, prime)`、`e_i ∈ [0, prime)`、`s_i ≥ 0`，以及 `sum(e) mod prime` 等于转录挑战——由此把承诺六字段（`element`、`lower`、`upper`、`prime`、`generator`、`h`）、声明区间与 `context` 全部绑定。上述结构、区间、挑战或任何绑定（承诺、`context`）不符都返回 `False`，允许短路。
249	
250	通过结构校验后，**每条 RangeProof 分支**（每个条目的每个区间偏移 `i`）恰调用一次 `randbelow(prime - 1)` 得 `r`，取非零系数 `a = r + 1`；`D_i = element * generator**(-i) mod prime` 的定义与单点验证完全一致。所有分支按 `(prime, generator, h)` 分组，每组只检查一次聚合等式
251	
252	```
253	h**Σ(a*s) == Π(t**a * D_i**(a*e))   (mod prime)
254	```
255	
256	即把该组内所有条目的全部分支纳入同一个随机线性组合，而**不是**逐分支或逐条目验证后做布尔汇总——因此同组内响应误差可以在系数为 1 时相消，而不同 `(prime, generator, h)`（不同群或不同 `h`）之间不能跨组相消。传入固定的 `randbelow` 结果可重复，缺省为 `secrets.randbelow`。
257	
258	类型错误（含 `bool` 整数、非元组证明字段、非 `bytes` 的 `context`、`randbelow` 不可调用或返回非整数）抛 `TypeError`；系数来源返回值超出 `[0, prime - 1)` 抛 `ValueError`。其余非法结构、篡改、承诺/context 绑定错误均返回 `False`；入口不改写任何输入。这里的随机线性组合只供演示。
259	
260	### 二维区域成员非交互证明
261	
262	`prove_region(x_commitment, y_commitment, x, y, x_blinding, y_blinding, region, context=b"")` 把"承诺的 `(x, y)` 落在 `Region(min_x, max_x, min_y, max_y)` 内"拆成两条轴上的区间证明：x 承诺的声明区间必须恰好等于 `(region.min_x, region.max_x)`，y 承诺必须恰好等于 `(region.min_y, region.max_y)`，生成时先校验区间匹配，再复用 `prove_range` 验证开合并生成子证明。证明为冻结的 `RegionProof(x_proof, y_proof)`，两字段均为 `RangeProof`；验证方调用 `verify_region(x_commitment, y_commitment, region, proof, context=b"")`，只需两个承诺、区域与证明，无需坐标或盲因子。
263	
264	每条轴的子证明在派生 context 下进行，派生 context 按以下项目逐项前置四字节无符号大端长度拼接：域 `b"zkregion/region/v1"`、轴标签 `b"x"` 或 `b"y"`、外部 `context`、Region 四边界（`min_x`、`max_x`、`min_y`、`max_y`）、x 承诺六字段、y 承诺六字段（均按数据类字段顺序）；整数编码为十进制 ASCII。因此证明同时绑定区域、外部 context、两个承诺与轴分配——更换区域、context、承诺或交换两轴（含交换子证明、交换承诺）都验证失败。
265	
266	`context` 只接受 `bytes`，所有整数拒绝 `bool`；承诺、区域、证明对象或其字段、数值类型错误抛 `TypeError`。生成时区间不匹配、开合无效或轴区间超过 256 个整数抛 `ValueError`；验证时上述非类型错误、结构非法、篡改或绑定不符一律返回 `False`。入口均不改写输入。
267	
268	### 二维区域证明批量验证
269	
270	`verify_region_batch(entries, *, randbelow=secrets.randbelow)` 一次验证一批 `RegionBatchEntry`，每个条目就是 `verify_region` 的五个入参（`x_commitment`、`y_commitment`、`region`、`proof`、`context`，后者缺省 `b""`）冻结成的不可变数据类。`entries` 须为非字符串、非空序列：空批返回 `False`，重复条目合法并各自独立取系数。漏项无法被发现，批次完整性由调用方保证。
271	
272	每个条目逐字节复用既定的 Region 派生 context 与 RangeProof 转录：x/y 承诺的声明区间必须分别等于区域的 `(min_x, max_x)` / `(min_y, max_y)`，两个子证明必须都是 `RangeProof` 且 `t`/`e`/`s` 元组长度恰为各自轴区间的整数数，逐个校验 `t_i ∈ [1, prime)`、`e_i ∈ [0, prime)`、`s_i ≥ 0`，以及 `sum(e) mod prime` 等于转录挑战。上述结构、区间、挑战和或任何绑定（区域、承诺、外部 `context`、轴分配，含跨条目重组）不符都返回 `False`，允许短路。
273	
274	通过结构校验后，**每条 RangeProof 分支**（每个条目的每个轴偏移 `i`）恰调用一次 `randbelow(prime - 1)` 得 `r`，取非零系数 `a = r + 1`；`D_i = element * generator**(-i) mod prime` 的定义与单点验证完全一致。所有分支按 `(prime, generator, h)` 分组，每组只检查一次聚合等式
275	
276	```
277	h**Σ(a*s) == Π(t**a * D_i**(a*e))   (mod prime)
278	```
279	
280	即把该组内所有条目的两条轴、全部分支纳入同一个随机线性组合，而**不是**逐条分支或逐条目验证后做布尔汇总——因此同组内响应误差可以在系数为 1 时相消，而不同 `(prime, generator, h)`（不同群或不同 `h`）之间不能跨组相消。传入固定的 `randbelow` 结果可重复，缺省为 `secrets.randbelow`。
281	
282	类型错误（含 `bool` 整数、非元组证明字段、非 `bytes` 的 `context`、`randbelow` 不可调用或返回非整数）抛 `TypeError`；系数来源返回值超出 `[0, prime - 1)` 抛 `ValueError`。其余非法结构、篡改、区域/承诺/context 绑定错误、跨项重组、子证明数量错误均返回 `False`；入口不改写任何输入。与 Schnorr 批量验证一样，这里的随机线性组合只供演示。
283	
284	### Fiat-Shamir 转录
285	
286	挑战 `c` 为 SHA-256 摘要的大端整数模 `prime`。转录依次写入固定域 `b"zkregion/schnorr-fs/v1"`、`prime`、`generator`、`public_key`、`t`、`context`、`message`；每项前置四字节无符号大端长度，整数取最短无符号大端编码。证明使用独立的临时随机数 `k`，与交互式 nonce 互不影响；应答 `s` 仍按普通整数计算、不针对群阶取模。
287	
288	### Schnorr 批量验证
289	
290	`verify_batch` 验证同一公钥下的一批 Fiat-Shamir 证明。`entries` 须为 `SchnorrBatchEntry` 的非字符串序列（空批返回 `False`）；每个结构合法的条目按既有转录重算挑战 `c`，并恰调用一次 `randbelow(prime - 1)` 得 `r`，取非零系数 `a = r + 1`，最终只检查一次聚合等式 `g**Σ(a*s) == Π(t**a * public_key**(a*c)) (mod prime)`，而非逐项验证的布尔汇总。重复条目合法，各自独立取系数；传入固定的 `randbelow` 结果可重复，缺省为 `secrets.randbelow`。
291	
292	`entries`、条目字段、`proof` 或 `randbelow` 的类型错误抛 `TypeError`（`bool` 不算整数）；系数来源返回非整数抛 `TypeError`，超出 `[0, prime - 1)` 抛 `ValueError`。commitment 越界、response 为负、消息或 context 不匹配、错误公钥或任一篡改均返回 `False`，无效证明允许短路。验证不改写输入，也不触碰证明方的交互式 nonce。注意：默认群与这里的随机线性组合仅供演示，未做生产级安全分析。
293	
294	### 多公钥 Schnorr 批量验证
295	
296	`verify_schnorr_batch(entries, *, randbelow=secrets.randbelow)` 一次验证可能分属不同公钥、不同群的一批 Fiat-Shamir 证明：每个条目是冻结数据类 `MultiSchnorrEntry(public_key, message, proof, context=b"", prime=DEFAULT_PRIME, generator=DEFAULT_GENERATOR)`，字段依次为 `int`、`bytes`、`SchnorrProof` 及缺省的 `context:bytes`、`prime:int`、`generator:int`，六字段都可位置构造；条目值相等即相等且不可变。`entries` 须为非字符串、非空序列：空批返回 `False`，重复条目合法并各自独立取系数。漏项无法被发现，批次完整性由调用方保证。
297	
298	每个条目逐字节复用既定的 Fiat-Shamir 转录（域、`prime`、`generator`、`public_key`、`t`、`context`、`message`）重算挑战 `c`，由此把条目六字段全部绑定。通过结构校验后，**每个条目恰调用一次** `randbelow(prime - 1)` 得 `r`，取非零系数 `a = r + 1`。条目按 `(prime, generator)` 分组，每组只检查一次聚合等式
299	
300	```
301	g**Σ(a*s) == Π(t**a * public_key**(a*c))   (mod prime)
302	```
303	
304	即同组内所有条目（可属不同 `public_key`，各自使用自身公钥）纳入同一个随机线性组合，而**不是**逐条目验证后做布尔汇总；不同 `(prime, generator)` 群之间不能跨组相消。传入固定的 `randbelow` 结果可重复，缺省为 `secrets.randbelow`。
305	
306	`entries`、条目字段或 `randbelow` 的类型错误抛 `TypeError`（`bool` 不算整数；非 `bytes` 的 `message`/`context` 同样拒绝）；系数来源返回非整数抛 `TypeError`，超出 `[0, prime - 1)` 抛 `ValueError`。群参数非法、公钥或 commitment 越界、response 为负、消息/context 不匹配或任一篡改均返回 `False`，无效条目允许短路。入口不改写任何输入。与单公钥批量验证一样，这里的随机线性组合只供演示。
307	
308	### Merkle 承诺的 Schnorr 完整批验
309	
310	`BoundSchnorrBatch(entries, leaf_count, proof)` 把一批**完整**的多公钥 Schnorr 条目与一棵 Merkle 树的多包含证明冻结在一起，三个字段依次为：
311	
312	1. `entries: tuple[MultiSchnorrEntry, ...]` —— 必须是元组（不是列表），每项是 `MultiSchnorrEntry`；
313	2. `leaf_count: int` —— 正的非 `bool` 整数，且必须同时等于 `len(entries)` 与 `proof.leaf_count`；
314	3. `proof: MerkleMultiProof` —— 其 `indices` 必须无缺口、无重复、无乱序地恰好覆盖 `0 .. leaf_count - 1`（即等于 `tuple(range(leaf_count))`）。
315	
316	三字段均可位置构造，对象按值相等且不可变（冻结 dataclass）。空批（`leaf_count < 1` 或 `entries` 为空）、缺项（数量不符）、`leaf_count` 与任一方不一致、索引乱序/重复/有缺口均返回 `False`。
317	
318	每个条目的 Merkle 叶字节由既有 Fiat-Shamir 转录的七个四字节无符号大端长度前缀项目构成——域 `b"zkregion/schnorr-fs/v1"`、`prime`、`generator`、`public_key`、`t`（commitment）、`context`、`message`，整数取最短无符号大端编码——末尾再以同样成帧方式追加 response 的最短无符号大端编码（共八个成帧项目；字段顺序沿用 Fiat-Shamir 转录）。叶摘要仍按 Merkle 树构造一节的 `SHA-256(b"\x00" + len4 + leaf)` 计算。
319	
320	`verify_bound(batch, root, *, randbelow=secrets.randbelow) -> bool` 的验证分两步、次序固定：
321	
322	1. 先以全部 `(index, leaf)`（`index` 即 0 起的条目位置）调用 `verify_multi_inclusion` 校验 Merkle 根；任一叶字节、proof 或根不符即返回 `False`，且在根校验通过前不消费任何随机数；
323	2. 根通过后，以**同一个 `randbelow`** 调用 `verify_schnorr_batch(entries, randbelow=randbelow)` 验签，随机源契约（每结构合法条目恰调用一次 `randbelow(prime - 1)`、非整数返回 `TypeError`、越界返回 `ValueError`）与输入完全沿用后者，不做包装或改动。
324	
325	类型错误——`batch` 不是 `BoundSchnorrBatch`、`entries` 不是元组或含非 `MultiSchnorrEntry`、条目嵌套字段类型错误（含 `bool` 整数、非 `bytes` 的 `message`/`context`、非 `SchnorrProof`）、`leaf_count` 不是非 `bool` 整数、`proof`/`root` 类型错误、`randbelow` 不可调用——抛 `TypeError`；其余一切无效情形（空批、缺项、数量不符、索引缺口/重复/乱序、错误根、叶字节篡改、签名或转录不符、非随机随机源导致的 `False` 等）均返回 `False`。入口不改写任何输入。与其它批量验证一样，这里的随机线性组合只供演示。
326	
327	### Merkle 承诺的区域证明完整批验
328	
329	`BoundRegionBatch(entries, leaf_count, proof)` 把一批**完整**的区域证明条目与一棵 Merkle 树的多包含证明冻结在一起，三个字段依次为：
330	
331	1. `entries: tuple[RegionBatchEntry, ...]` —— 必须是元组（不是列表），每项是 `RegionBatchEntry`；
332	2. `leaf_count: int` —— 正的非 `bool` 整数，且必须同时等于 `len(entries)` 与 `proof.leaf_count`；
333	3. `proof: MerkleMultiProof` —— 其 `indices` 必须无缺口、无重复、无乱序地恰好覆盖 `0 .. leaf_count - 1`（即等于 `tuple(range(leaf_count))`）。
334	
335	三字段均可位置构造，对象按值相等且不可变（冻结 dataclass）。空批（`leaf_count < 1` 或 `entries` 为空）、缺项（数量不符）、`leaf_count` 与任一方不一致、索引乱序/重复/有缺口均返回 `False`。
336	
337	每个条目的 Merkle 叶字节以域 `b"zkregion/region-bound/v1"` 开始，依次拼接：x 承诺六字段、y 承诺六字段（均按数据类字段顺序）、Region 四边界（`min_x`、`max_x`、`min_y`、`max_y`）与 `context`，再依次写入 x、y 各自子证明的 `t`、`e`、`s` 序列——每个序列先写十进制元素数再逐项写值。每个原子项前置四字节无符号大端长度，整数编码为十进制 ASCII（负号保留）。叶摘要仍按 Merkle 树构造一节的 `SHA-256(b"\x00" + len4 + leaf)` 计算。
338	
339	`verify_region_bound(batch, root, *, randbelow=secrets.randbelow) -> bool` 的验证分两步、次序固定：
340	
341	1. 先以全部 `(index, leaf)`（`index` 即 0 起的条目位置）调用 `verify_multi_inclusion` 校验 Merkle 根；任一叶字节、proof 或根不符即返回 `False`，且在根校验通过前不消费任何随机数；
342	2. 根通过后，以**同一个 `randbelow`** 调用 `verify_region_batch(entries, randbelow=randbelow)` 验子证明，随机源契约（每结构合法分支恰调用一次 `randbelow(prime - 1)`、非整数返回 `TypeError`、越界返回 `ValueError`）与输入完全沿用后者，不做包装或改动。
343	
344	类型错误——`batch` 不是 `BoundRegionBatch`、`entries` 不是元组或含非 `RegionBatchEntry`、条目嵌套字段类型错误（含 `bool` 整数、非 `bytes` 的 `context`、非 `RegionProof`/`RangeProof`、非元组 `t`/`e`/`s`）、`leaf_count` 不是非 `bool` 整数、`proof`/`root` 类型错误、`randbelow` 不可调用——抛 `TypeError`；其余一切无效情形（空批、缺项、数量不符、索引缺口/重复/乱序、错误根、叶字节篡改、子证明或转录不符、非随机随机源导致的 `False` 等）均返回 `False`。入口不改写任何输入。与其它批量验证一样，这里的随机线性组合只供演示。
345	
346	## 限制
347	
348	`DEFAULT_PRIME` 是梅森素数而非安全素数，`2**127 - 2` 的因子分解不干净，因此这里没有可用的素数阶子群，应答按普通整数计算、不针对群阶取模；安全性只够做协议演示，不足以用于真实部署。区域判定只是朴素的坐标比较，不检查坐标是否经过承诺绑定；批量验证所用的随机线性组合与默认群一样仅供演示。Pedersen 承诺默认的 `h = g**2 mod prime` 带有公开陷门、破坏绑定性；其上的 Schnorr OR 区间证明与二维区域成员证明同样是演示级构造——区间上限 256 个整数、挑战来自 SHA-256 Fiat-Shamir 转录、群参数与默认 `h` 均未做生产级安全分析，不能用于真实部署。
349	
350	## 测试
351	
352	```bash
353	python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
354	```

# zkregion

面向区域成员关系的承诺与交互式证明原语。提供哈希承诺、素域乘法群上的 Schnorr 交互证明、确定性 SHA-256 Merkle 包含证明、量化区间的 Pedersen 陷门承诺及其上的 Schnorr OR 非交互区间证明、二维矩形区域成员非交互证明，以及量化整数坐标下的矩形区域判定。

## 环境

Python 3.10+，只依赖标准库（`hashlib`、`hmac`、`secrets`）。

## 使用

```python
from zkregion import Region, SchnorrProof, SchnorrProver, SchnorrVerifier, commit, verify_opening

commitment, nonce = commit(b"coordinate")
assert verify_opening(commitment, b"coordinate", nonce)

prover = SchnorrProver(secret=12345)
verifier = SchnorrVerifier(prover.public_key)
t = prover.new_commitment()
c = 987654321
s = prover.respond(c)
assert verifier.verify(t, c, s)

# 非交互 Fiat-Shamir 证明
proof = prover.prove(b"payload", context=b"session-1")
assert verifier.verify_proof(b"payload", proof, context=b"session-1")

# 同一公钥的批量验证
from zkregion import SchnorrBatchEntry

batch = [
    SchnorrBatchEntry(b"alpha", prover.prove(b"alpha", context=b"s1"), context=b"s1"),
    SchnorrBatchEntry(b"beta", prover.prove(b"beta", context=b"s1"), context=b"s1"),
]
assert verifier.verify_batch(batch)

# 多公钥 / 多群的批量验证（每个条目自带公钥与群参数）
from zkregion import MultiSchnorrEntry, verify_schnorr_batch

other = SchnorrProver(secret=987654321)
multi = [
    MultiSchnorrEntry(prover.public_key, b"alpha", prover.prove(b"alpha", context=b"s1"), context=b"s1"),
    MultiSchnorrEntry(other.public_key, b"beta", other.prove(b"beta", context=b"s1"), b"s1"),
]
assert verify_schnorr_batch(multi)

# Merkle 承诺的 Schnorr 完整批验：整批条目先提交到一棵 Merkle 树
from zkregion import BoundSchnorrBatch, merkle_root, prove_multi_inclusion, verify_bound

def enc(value):
    return value.to_bytes(max(1, (value.bit_length() + 7) // 8), "big")

def bound_leaf(entry):
    items = (
        b"zkregion/schnorr-fs/v1",
        enc(entry.prime), enc(entry.generator), enc(entry.public_key),
        enc(entry.proof.commitment), entry.context, entry.message,
        enc(entry.proof.response),
    )
    return b"".join(len(item).to_bytes(4, "big") + item for item in items)

leaves = [bound_leaf(entry) for entry in multi]
root = merkle_root(leaves)
proof = prove_multi_inclusion(leaves, tuple(range(len(leaves))))
batch = BoundSchnorrBatch(tuple(multi), len(multi), proof)
assert verify_bound(batch, root)

# Merkle 包含证明
from zkregion import prove_inclusion, verify_inclusion

leaves = [b"alpha", b"beta", b"gamma"]
root = merkle_root(leaves)
inclusion = prove_inclusion(leaves, 1)
assert verify_inclusion(b"beta", inclusion, root)

# Merkle 多包含证明（一次证明多片叶子，无需完整叶集即可验证）
from zkregion import verify_multi_inclusion

multi = prove_multi_inclusion(leaves, (0, 2))
entries = [(0, b"alpha"), (2, b"gamma")]
assert verify_multi_inclusion(entries, multi, root)

# Pedersen 陷门承诺：对区间 [lower, upper] 内的量化整数值做承诺
from zkregion import pedersen_commit, verify_pedersen_opening

commitment, blinding = pedersen_commit(40, 0, 100)
assert verify_pedersen_opening(commitment, 40, blinding)
assert not verify_pedersen_opening(commitment, 41, blinding)

# Pedersen 非交互区间证明（Schnorr OR）：证明承诺值落在声明区间内
from zkregion import prove_range, verify_range

proof = prove_range(commitment, 40, blinding, context=b"session-1")
assert verify_range(commitment, proof, context=b"session-1")
assert not verify_range(commitment, proof, context=b"other")

# 区间证明的批量验证（按 (prime, generator, h) 分组做随机线性组合）
from zkregion import RangeBatchEntry, verify_range_batch

range_batch = [
    RangeBatchEntry(commitment, proof, b"session-1"),
    RangeBatchEntry(commitment, proof, b"session-1"),
]
assert verify_range_batch(range_batch)

# 二维区域成员非交互证明：证明承诺的 (x, y) 落在矩形区域内
from zkregion import RegionProof, prove_region, verify_region

region = Region(0, 100, 0, 100)
x_commitment, x_blinding = pedersen_commit(40, 0, 100)
y_commitment, y_blinding = pedersen_commit(60, 0, 100)
region_proof = prove_region(
    x_commitment, y_commitment, 40, 60, x_blinding, y_blinding, region, context=b"session-1"
)
assert verify_region(x_commitment, y_commitment, region, region_proof, context=b"session-1")
assert not verify_region(x_commitment, y_commitment, region, region_proof, context=b"other")

# 二维区域证明的批量验证（按 (prime, generator, h) 分组做随机线性组合）
from zkregion import RegionBatchEntry, verify_region_batch

batch = [
    RegionBatchEntry(x_commitment, y_commitment, region, region_proof, b"session-1"),
    RegionBatchEntry(x_commitment, y_commitment, region, region_proof, b"session-1"),
]
assert verify_region_batch(batch)

# Merkle 承诺的区域证明完整批验：整批区域条目先提交到一棵 Merkle 树
from zkregion import BoundRegionBatch, verify_region_bound

def bound_region_leaf(entry):
    items = [b"zkregion/region-bound/v1"]
    for c in (entry.x_commitment, entry.y_commitment):
        items += [str(v).encode("ascii")
                  for v in (c.element, c.lower, c.upper, c.prime, c.generator, c.h)]
    r = entry.region
    items += [str(v).encode("ascii") for v in (r.min_x, r.max_x, r.min_y, r.max_y)]
    items.append(entry.context)
    for sub in (entry.proof.x_proof, entry.proof.y_proof):
        for seq in (sub.t, sub.e, sub.s):
            items.append(str(len(seq)).encode("ascii"))
            items += [str(v).encode("ascii") for v in seq]
    return b"".join(len(item).to_bytes(4, "big") + item for item in items)

region_leaves = [bound_region_leaf(entry) for entry in batch]
region_root = merkle_root(region_leaves)
region_proof = prove_multi_inclusion(region_leaves, tuple(range(len(region_leaves))))
bound_region = BoundRegionBatch(tuple(batch), len(batch), region_proof)
assert verify_region_bound(bound_region, region_root)

Region(0, 100, 0, 100).contains(50, 50)     # True
```

## 命令行演示

```bash
python3 -m zkregion
```

## 公开接口

- `DEFAULT_PRIME` / `DEFAULT_GENERATOR` — 默认群参数（`2**127 - 1` 与 `3`）
- `commit(value, *, nonce=None) -> (commitment, nonce)` — 哈希承诺，`nonce` 缺省随机 16 字节
- `verify_opening(commitment, value, nonce) -> bool` — 常量时间比对
- `commit_coordinate(x, y, *, nonce=None)` — 对整数坐标对做承诺
- `pedersen_commit(value, lower, upper, *, prime=DEFAULT_PRIME, generator=DEFAULT_GENERATOR, h=None, blinding=None, randbelow=secrets.randbelow) -> (PedersenCommitment, blinding)` — 区间量化值的 Pedersen 承诺
- `verify_pedersen_opening(commitment, value, blinding) -> bool` — 复用承诺对象内参数验证开合
- `PedersenCommitment(element, lower, upper, prime, generator, h)` — 不可变承诺对象；承诺值为 `element = g**(value-lower) * h**blinding mod prime`
- `prove_range(commitment, value, blinding, context=b"", *, randbelow=secrets.randbelow) -> RangeProof` — 生成 Pedersen 承诺的非交互区间证明（Schnorr OR）
- `verify_range(commitment, proof, context=b"") -> bool` — 验证区间证明
- `RangeProof(t, e, s)` — 不可变区间证明对象，三个字段均为长度 `upper - lower + 1` 的 `tuple[int, ...]`
- `verify_range_batch(entries, *, randbelow=secrets.randbelow) -> bool` — 区间证明的批量验证，按 `(prime, generator, h)` 分组做一次随机线性组合
- `RangeBatchEntry(commitment, proof, context=b"")` — 不可变批量验证条目，字段类型依次为 `PedersenCommitment`、`RangeProof`、`bytes`，字段次序与 `verify_range` 入参一致
- `prove_region(x_commitment, y_commitment, x, y, x_blinding, y_blinding, region, context=b"", *, randbelow=secrets.randbelow) -> RegionProof` — 生成二维矩形区域成员非交互证明
- `verify_region(x_commitment, y_commitment, region, proof, context=b"") -> bool` — 验证区域成员证明，无需坐标或盲因子
- `RegionProof(x_proof, y_proof)` — 不可变区域证明对象，两字段均为 `RangeProof`
- `verify_region_batch(entries, *, randbelow=secrets.randbelow) -> bool` — 区域证明的批量验证，按 `(prime, generator, h)` 分组做一次随机线性组合
- `RegionBatchEntry(x_commitment, y_commitment, region, proof, context=b"")` — 不可变批量验证条目，字段次序与 `verify_region` 入参一致
- `SchnorrProver(secret, *, prime, generator, randbelow)`
  - `public_key` — `g**secret mod prime`
  - `new_commitment()` — 生成一次性随机数并返回 `g**k mod prime`
  - `respond(challenge)` — 返回 `k + challenge * secret`（不取模）
  - `prove(message, *, context=b"") -> SchnorrProof` — Fiat-Shamir 非交互证明
- `SchnorrVerifier(public_key, *, prime, generator)`
  - `verify(commitment, challenge, response)` — 交互式验证
  - `verify_proof(message, proof, *, context=b"") -> bool` — 非交互证明验证
  - `verify_batch(entries, *, randbelow=secrets.randbelow) -> bool` — 同一公钥的批量验证
- `SchnorrProof(commitment, response)` — 不可变证明对象（`t = g**k mod prime`，`s = k + c * secret`）
- `SchnorrBatchEntry(message, proof, context=b"")` — 不可变批量验证条目，字段类型依次为 `bytes`、`SchnorrProof`、`bytes`
- `verify_schnorr_batch(entries, *, randbelow=secrets.randbelow) -> bool` — 多公钥批量验证，按 `(prime, generator)` 分组做一次随机线性组合
- `MultiSchnorrEntry(public_key, message, proof, context=b"", prime=DEFAULT_PRIME, generator=DEFAULT_GENERATOR)` — 不可变多公钥批量验证条目；前三字段依次为 `int`、`bytes`、`SchnorrProof`，均为必填且可位置构造，值相等即相等
- `verify_bound(batch, root, *, randbelow=secrets.randbelow) -> bool` — Merkle 承诺的 Schnorr 完整批验：先 `verify_multi_inclusion` 验根，再以同一 `randbelow` 调 `verify_schnorr_batch` 验签
- `BoundSchnorrBatch(entries, leaf_count, proof)` — 冻结的完整批对象；字段依次为 `tuple[MultiSchnorrEntry, ...]`、正的非 `bool` `int`、`MerkleMultiProof`，均可位置构造、按值相等且不可变
- `verify_region_bound(batch, root, *, randbelow=secrets.randbelow) -> bool` — Merkle 承诺的区域证明完整批验：先 `verify_multi_inclusion` 验根，再以同一 `randbelow` 调 `verify_region_batch` 验子证明
- `BoundRegionBatch(entries, leaf_count, proof)` — 冻结的完整批对象；字段依次为 `tuple[RegionBatchEntry, ...]`、正的非 `bool` `int`、`MerkleMultiProof`，均可位置构造、按值相等且不可变
- `merkle_root(leaves) -> bytes` — 非空 `bytes` 序列的 Merkle 根
- `prove_inclusion(leaves, index) -> MerkleProof` — 按零基索引生成包含证明
- `verify_inclusion(leaf, proof, root) -> bool` — 验证包含证明
- `MerkleProof(index, siblings)` — 不可变证明对象，`siblings` 为按叶到根排列的 `tuple[bytes, ...]`
- `prove_multi_inclusion(leaves, indices) -> MerkleMultiProof` — 为多片叶子生成紧凑的合并包含证明
- `verify_multi_inclusion(entries, proof, root) -> bool` — 无需完整叶集验证多包含证明；`entries` 按 `proof.indices` 顺序给出 `(index, leaf)`
- `MerkleMultiProof(leaf_count, indices, siblings)` — 不可变多包含证明对象，`indices` 为 `tuple[int, ...]`，`siblings` 为 `tuple[bytes, ...]`
- `Region(min_x, max_x, min_y, max_y)` — 闭区间矩形；`contains(x, y)`

### Merkle 树构造

叶摘要为 `SHA-256(b"\x00" + len4 + leaf)`，其中 `len4` 是叶长的四字节无符号大端编码；内部节点摘要为 `SHA-256(b"\x01" + left + right)`。每层按输入顺序两两合并，奇数节点复制末项后再合并；单叶树的根就是叶摘要，证明路径为空。重复叶按调用方给出的零基索引定位，不按内容搜索。`leaves` 为空抛 `ValueError`，叶或索引类型错误抛 `TypeError`，索引越界抛 `IndexError`。验证时 `leaf`、`root` 与各兄弟摘要须为 `bytes`（后两者恰 32 字节），`proof` 须为 `MerkleProof` 且 `index` 为非负整数；类型错误抛 `TypeError`，摘要长度或索引结构非法返回 `False`。验证按 `index` 奇偶决定左右顺序并逐层整除二；叶、索引、路径或根被篡改均返回 `False`，所有入口均不改写输入。

### Merkle 多包含证明

多包含证明复用同一套哈希与奇数末项复制规则，把多片叶子的路径合并为一个证明。`indices` 须非空、严格递增且无重复；生成时逐层从左到右处理：兄弟节点本身也在被证明之列则直接合并、无需收集，奇数层末项无兄弟则自复制，其余情况才收集兄弟摘要；父层位置按 `position // 2` 去重。证明确定且最小——证明全部叶子时 `siblings` 为空。验证方只需 `entries`（按 `proof.indices` 顺序给出的 `(index, leaf)`）、证明与根，无需完整叶集；按同一规则逐层恢复根，且必须恰好耗尽全部 `siblings`，否则返回 `False`。

生成时 `leaves` 须为非空 `bytes` 序列；`leaf_count` 须为正的非 bool 整数，索引须为范围内的非 bool 整数。类型错误抛 `TypeError`，`indices` 为空、重复或乱序抛 `ValueError`，越界抛 `IndexError`。验证时 `entries` 的索引序列须与 `proof.indices` 完全一致；`entries`、`proof`、`root` 或摘要的类型错误抛 `TypeError`；空项、乱序、越界、数量不符、摘要长度错误及任何篡改均返回 `False`。

### Pedersen 量化坐标陷门承诺

`pedersen_commit(value, lower, upper, ...)` 对声明在闭区间 `[lower, upper]` 内的量化整数值做 Pedersen 承诺：编码消息为偏移量 `m = value - lower`，承诺元素为

```
element = g**m * h**r mod prime
```

其中 `r` 为盲因子。`prime` 与 `g` 缺省取 `DEFAULT_PRIME` / `DEFAULT_GENERATOR`；`h` 缺省为 `g**2 mod prime`；盲因子缺省由 `randbelow(prime - 2) + 1` 生成（缺省源为 `secrets.randbelow`），也可用 `blinding=` 显式给出。函数返回 `(PedersenCommitment, blinding)`，承诺对象是冻结的 dataclass，携带 `element`、`lower`、`upper`、`prime`、`generator`、`h`，验证方无需其他带外参数。

约束：必须有 `lower <= value <= upper`，且区间宽度 `upper - lower < prime - 1`；盲因子须在 `[1, prime - 1)`；`prime > 3`，`g` 与 `h` 均须位于 `(1, prime)`——无论 `h` 是显式传入还是按缺省 `g**2 mod prime` 计算，都会校验 `1 < h < prime`，不满足抛 `ValueError`。所有数值只接受非 `bool` 整数（`True`/`False` 不算整数）：`value`、边界、`prime`、`g`、`h`、`blinding` 类型错误抛 `TypeError`；`randbelow` 不可调用或其返回值不是整数抛 `TypeError`。非法区间、越界 `value`、非法群参数或盲因子越界抛 `ValueError`；`randbelow` 返回值超出 `[0, prime - 2)` 也抛 `ValueError`。

`verify_pedersen_opening(commitment, value, blinding)` 只复用承诺对象内的群参数与区间，按同一公式重算并比对：`commitment` 不是 `PedersenCommitment` 或其字段、`value`、`blinding` 类型错误时抛 `TypeError`；对象内 `element` 或群参数越界、区间非法、`value` 越界、盲因子越界，或开合错误（错误的 `value`/`blinding`/`element`）一律返回 `False`。验证不改写任何输入。

> **警告：默认 `h = g**2 mod prime` 的离散对数（`log_g(h) = 2`）是公开已知的，因此默认配置下的承诺不具备绑定性**——知道陷门即可对同一 `element` 给出多个开合（例如 `(value, r)` 与 `(value + 2, r - 1)`），演示程序会展示这一点。生产用途必须传入离散对数未知（无可信设置陷门）的 `h`。此外，单独的承诺对象只是带区间声明的承诺；"承诺值属于某区间" 的零知识论断由下文的 `prove_range` / `verify_range` 提供，且同样只是演示级安全强度。

### Pedersen 非交互区间证明

`prove_range(commitment, value, blinding, context=b"")` 在 Pedersen 承诺之上生成 Schnorr OR 风格的非交互区间证明，`verify_range(commitment, proof, context=b"")` 验证。对声明区间 `[lower, upper]` 内的每个偏移 `i`（共 `n = upper - lower + 1` 个，**最多 256 个整数**，超限生成抛 `ValueError`、验证返回 `False`）定义

```
D_i = element * g**(-i) mod prime
```

承诺以 `(value, r)` 开合当且仅当 `D_(value-lower) = h**r`，因此区间证明等价于"至少一个 `D_i` 以 `h` 为底的离散对数等于盲因子 `r`" 的 OR 证明。真实分支走诚实 Schnorr：取随机 `k`，`t = h**k mod prime`，挑战份额 `e = (c - Σ其他 e_i) mod prime`，响应 `s = k + e * r`（非负、不取模）；其余分支模拟：随机取 `e_i ∈ [0, prime)` 与非负 `s_i`，令 `t_i = h**s_i * D_i**(-e_i) mod prime`。证明为冻结的 `RangeProof(t, e, s)`，三个字段都是长度 `n` 的整数元组。

挑战 `c` 为 SHA-256 摘要的大端整数模 `prime`。转录依次写入域 `b"zkregion/pedersen-range/v1"`、承诺六字段（`element`、`lower`、`upper`、`prime`、`generator`、`h`）、`context`、`n` 与全部 `t_i`；每项前置四字节无符号大端长度，整数编码为十进制 ASCII。

验证要求：每个 `t_i ∈ [1, prime)`、`e_i ∈ [0, prime)`、`s_i ≥ 0`，`sum(e) mod prime == c`，且每个分支满足 Schnorr 等式 `h**s_i == t_i * D_i**e_i (mod prime)`。生成前会先复用 `verify_pedersen_opening` 校验开合，开合不符抛 `ValueError`；类型错误（含 `bool` 整数、非元组证明字段、非 `bytes` 的 `context`、不可调用的 `randbelow`）抛 `TypeError`；其他非法结构、篡改或绑定不符（错误的承诺、`context` 或证明）一律返回 `False`。入口均不改写输入。

### 区间证明批量验证

`verify_range_batch(entries, *, randbelow=secrets.randbelow)` 一次验证一批 `RangeProof`，每个条目就是 `verify_range` 的三个入参（`commitment`、`proof`、`context`，后者缺省 `b""`）冻结成的不可变数据类 `RangeBatchEntry`；字段类型依次为 `PedersenCommitment`、`RangeProof`、`bytes`。`entries` 须为非字符串、非空序列：空批返回 `False`，重复条目合法并各自独立取系数。漏项无法被发现，批次完整性由调用方保证。

每个条目逐字节复用既定的 RangeProof 转录与结构校验：证明的 `t`/`e`/`s` 元组长度必须恰为承诺声明区间的整数数，逐个校验 `t_i ∈ [1, prime)`、`e_i ∈ [0, prime)`、`s_i ≥ 0`，以及 `sum(e) mod prime` 等于转录挑战——由此把承诺六字段（`element`、`lower`、`upper`、`prime`、`generator`、`h`）、声明区间与 `context` 全部绑定。上述结构、区间、挑战或任何绑定（承诺、`context`）不符都返回 `False`，允许短路。

### Fiat-Shamir 转录

挑战 `c` 为 SHA-256 摘要的大端整数模 `prime`。转录依次写入固定域 `b"zkregion/schnorr-fs/v1"`、`prime`、`generator`、`public_key`、`t`、`context`、`message`；每项前置四字节无符号大端长度，整数取最短无符号大端编码。证明使用独立的临时随机数 `k`，与交互式 nonce 互不影响；应答 `s` 仍按普通整数计算、不针对群阶取模。

`verify_batch` 验证同一公钥下的一批 Fiat-Shamir 证明。`entries` 须为 `SchnorrBatchEntry` 的非字符串序列（空批返回 `False`）；每个结构合法的条目按既有转录重算挑战 `c`，并恰调用一次 `randbelow(prime - 1)` 得 `r`，取非零系数 `a = r + 1`，最终只检查一次聚合等式 `g**Σ(a*s) == Π(t**a * public_key**(a*c)) (mod prime)`，而非逐项验证的布尔汇总。重复条目合法，各自独立取系数；传入固定的 `randbelow` 结果可重复，缺省为 `secrets.randbelow`。

`entries`、条目字段、`proof` 或 `randbelow` 的类型错误抛 `TypeError`（`bool` 不算整数）；系数来源返回非整数抛 `TypeError`，超出 `[0, prime - 1)` 抛 `ValueError`。commitment 越界、response 为负、消息或 context 不匹配、错误公钥或任一篡改均返回 `False`，无效证明允许短路。验证不改写输入，也不触碰证明方的交互式 nonce。注意：默认群与这里的随机线性组合仅供演示，未做生产级安全分析。

### Merkle 承诺的 Schnorr 完整批验

`BoundSchnorrBatch(entries, leaf_count, proof)` 把一批**完整**的多公钥 Schnorr 条目与一棵 Merkle 树的多包含证明冻结在一起，三个字段依次为：

1. `entries: tuple[MultiSchnorrEntry, ...]` —— 必须是元组（不是列表），每项是 `MultiSchnorrEntry`；
2. `leaf_count: int` —— 正的非 `bool` 整数，且必须同时等于 `len(entries)` 与 `proof.leaf_count`；
3. `proof: MerkleMultiProof` —— 其 `indices` 必须无缺口、无重复、无乱序地恰好覆盖 `0 .. leaf_count - 1`（即等于 `tuple(range(leaf_count))`）。

三字段均可位置构造，对象按值相等且不可变（冻结 dataclass）。空批（`leaf_count < 1` 或 `entries` 为空）、缺项（数量不符）、`leaf_count` 与任一方不一致、索引乱序/重复/有缺口均返回 `False`。

每个条目的 Merkle 叶字节由既有 Fiat-Shamir 转录的七个四字节无符号大端长度前缀项目构成——域 `b"zkregion/schnorr-fs/v1"`、`prime`、`generator`、`public_key`、`t`（commitment）、`context`、`message`，整数取最短无符号大端编码——末尾再以同样成帧方式追加 response 的最短无符号大端编码（共八个成帧项目；字段顺序沿用 Fiat-Shamir 转录）。叶摘要仍按 Merkle 树构造一节的 `SHA-256(b"\x00" + len4 + leaf)` 计算。

`verify_bound(batch, root, *, randbelow=secrets.randbelow) -> bool` 的验证分两步、次序固定：

1. 先以全部 `(index, leaf)`（`index` 即 0 起的条目位置）调用 `verify_multi_inclusion` 校验 Merkle 根；任一叶字节、proof 或根不符即返回 `False`，且在根校验通过前不消费任何随机数；

## 限制

`DEFAULT_PRIME` 是梅森素数而非安全素数，`2**127 - 2` 的因子分解不干净，因此这里没有可用的素数阶子群，应答按普通整数计算、不针对群阶取模；安全性只够做协议演示，不足以用于真实部署。区域判定只是朴素的坐标比较，不检查坐标是否经过承诺绑定；批量验证所用的随机线性组合与默认群一样仅供演示。Pedersen 承诺默认的 `h = g**2 mod prime` 带有公开陷门、破坏绑定性；其上的 Schnorr OR 区间证明与二维区域成员证明同样是演示级构造——区间上限 256 个整数、挑战来自 SHA-256 Fiat-Shamir 转录、群参数与默认 `h` 均未做生产级安全分析，不能用于真实部署。

168	@dataclass(frozen=True)
169	class PedersenCommitment:
170	    """A Pedersen commitment over a multiplicative group modulo ``prime``.
171	
172	    Fields:
173	
174	    - ``element`` — the commitment ``C = g**m * h**r mod prime``, where the
175	      message is the offset ``m = value - lower``;
176	    - ``lower`` / ``upper`` — inclusive quantized range declared at commit;
177	    - ``prime`` / ``generator`` — modulus and base ``g``;
178	    - ``h`` — the blinding base.
179	
180	    .. warning::
181	       With the default ``h = g**2 mod prime`` the discrete logarithm
182	       ``log_g(h) = 2`` is publicly known, so the commitment is **not
183	       binding**: anyone can open one commitment to several values. It is a
184	       demonstration trapdoor commitment; the accompanying
185	       :func:`prove_range` / :func:`verify_range` range proof inherits the
186	       same demonstration-only security level.
187	    """
188	
189	    element: int
190	    lower: int
191	    upper: int
192	    prime: int
193	    generator: int
194	    h: int
195	
196	
197	def _check_int(value: object, name: str) -> None:
198	    """Numbers are non-bool integers; bool is rejected everywhere."""
199	    if not isinstance(value, int) or isinstance(value, bool):
200	        raise TypeError(f"{name} must be an integer")
201	
202	
203	def pedersen_commit(
204	    value: int,
205	    lower: int,
206	    upper: int,
207	    *,
208	    prime: int = DEFAULT_PRIME,
209	    generator: int = DEFAULT_GENERATOR,
210	    h: int | None = None,
211	    blinding: int | None = None,
212	    randbelow: Callable[[int], int] = secrets.randbelow,
213	) -> tuple[PedersenCommitment, int]:
214	    """Commit to ``value`` inside the inclusive range ``[lower, upper]``.
215	
216	    Returns ``(commitment, blinding)``. The encoded message is the offset
217	    ``m = value - lower`` and the commitment is ``g**m * h**r mod prime``.
218	    ``lower <= value <= upper`` must hold and the range width
219	    ``upper - lower`` must be strictly smaller than ``prime - 1``.
220	
221	    ``prime`` and ``generator`` (``g``) default to :data:`DEFAULT_PRIME` and
222	    :data:`DEFAULT_GENERATOR`; ``h`` defaults to ``g**2 mod prime``, whose
223	    discrete log is publicly known (see the trapdoor warning on
224	    :class:`PedersenCommitment`). Whether given explicitly or computed from
225	    the default, ``h`` must satisfy ``1 < h < prime``. The blinding ``r``
226	    defaults to ``randbelow(prime - 2) + 1`` and must lie in
227	    ``[1, prime - 1)``; the default source is :func:`secrets.randbelow`.
228	
229	    Type errors (including non-callable ``randbelow`` or a non-integer value
230	    drawn from it) raise :class:`TypeError`; an invalid range, an out-of-range
231	    value, bad group parameters or a bad blinding raise :class:`ValueError`.
232	    """
233	    _check_int(value, "value")
234	    _check_int(lower, "lower")
235	    _check_int(upper, "upper")
236	    _check_int(prime, "prime")
237	    _check_int(generator, "generator")
238	    if prime <= 3:
239	        raise ValueError("prime must be greater than 3")
240	    if not 1 < generator < prime:
241	        raise ValueError("generator must satisfy 1 < generator < prime")
242	    if h is None:
243	        h = pow(generator, 2, prime)
244	    else:
245	        _check_int(h, "h")
246	    if not 1 < h < prime:
247	        raise ValueError("h must satisfy 1 < h < prime")
248	    if lower > upper:
249	        raise ValueError("lower must not exceed upper")
250	    if not lower <= value <= upper:
251	        raise ValueError("value must satisfy lower <= value <= upper")
252	    if upper - lower >= prime - 1:
253	        raise ValueError("range width (upper - lower) must be smaller than prime - 1")
254	    if blinding is None:
255	        if not callable(randbelow):
256	            raise TypeError("randbelow must be callable")
257	        drawn = randbelow(prime - 2)
258	        _check_int(drawn, "randbelow return value")
259	        if not 0 <= drawn < prime - 2:
260	            raise ValueError("randbelow must return a value in [0, prime - 2)")
261	        blinding = drawn + 1
262	    else:
263	        _check_int(blinding, "blinding")
264	        if not 1 <= blinding < prime - 1:
265	            raise ValueError("blinding must satisfy 1 <= blinding < prime - 1")
266	    message = value - lower
267	    element = (pow(generator, message, prime) * pow(h, blinding, prime)) % prime
268	    return (
269	        PedersenCommitment(
270	            element=element,
271	            lower=lower,
272	            upper=upper,
273	            prime=prime,
274	            generator=generator,
275	            h=h,
276	        ),
277	        blinding,
278	    )

281	def verify_pedersen_opening(
282	    commitment: PedersenCommitment,
283	    value: int,
284	    blinding: int,
285	) -> bool:
286	    """Verify that ``commitment`` opens at ``value`` with ``blinding``.
287	
288	    The group parameters and declared range come from ``commitment`` itself.
289	    A wrong object or field type raises :class:`TypeError`; an out-of-range
290	    element or value, or an incorrect opening, returns ``False``. Inputs are
291	    never mutated.
292	    """
293	    if not isinstance(commitment, PedersenCommitment):
294	        raise TypeError("commitment must be a PedersenCommitment")
295	    for name in ("element", "lower", "upper", "prime", "generator", "h"):
296	        _check_int(getattr(commitment, name), f"commitment {name}")
297	    _check_int(value, "value")
298	    _check_int(blinding, "blinding")
299	    prime = commitment.prime
300	    if prime <= 3:
301	        return False
302	    if not 1 < commitment.generator < prime or not 1 < commitment.h < prime:
303	        return False
304	    if not 0 < commitment.element < prime:
305	        return False
306	    if commitment.lower > commitment.upper:
307	        return False
308	    if commitment.upper - commitment.lower >= prime - 1:
309	        return False
310	    if not commitment.lower <= value <= commitment.upper:
311	        return False
312	    if not 1 <= blinding < prime - 1:
313	        return False
314	    message = value - commitment.lower
315	    expected = (
316	        pow(commitment.generator, message, prime)
317	        * pow(commitment.h, blinding, prime)
318	        % prime
319	    )
320	    return expected == commitment.element

323	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
324	# Non-interactive Pedersen range proofs (Schnorr OR over the offsets)
325	#
326	# For each offset i in [0, n) define D_i = element * generator**(-i) mod prime.
327	# The commitment opens at value = lower + j with blinding r exactly when
328	# D_j = h**r, so a range proof is an OR proof: "I know the base-h discrete
329	# logarithm of at least one D_i". The real branch runs an honest Schnorr
330	# round; every other branch is simulated, and the Fiat-Shamir challenge
331	# shares are chosen so they sum to the transcript challenge modulo prime.
332	
333	_RANGE_DOMAIN = b"zkregion/pedersen-range/v1"
334	_MAX_RANGE_VALUES = 256
335	
336	
337	@dataclass(frozen=True)
338	class RangeProof:
339	    """A non-interactive range proof over a :class:`PedersenCommitment`.
340	
341	    ``t`` holds the per-branch announcements, ``e`` the challenge shares and
342	    ``s`` the responses; all three are tuples of ``upper - lower + 1``
343	    integers, one per integer in the declared range.
344	    """
345	
346	    t: tuple[int, ...]
347	    e: tuple[int, ...]
348	    s: tuple[int, ...]
349	
350	
351	def _range_challenge(
352	    commitment: PedersenCommitment,
353	    context: bytes,
354	    size: int,
355	    announcements: tuple[int, ...],
356	) -> int:
357	    """SHA-256 transcript challenge as a big-endian integer mod ``prime``.
358	
359	    The transcript is the domain separator, the six commitment fields, the
360	    context, the range size ``n`` and every announcement ``t_i``; each item
361	    is prefixed with its four-byte big-endian length and integers are
362	    encoded as decimal ASCII.
363	    """
364	    fields = (
365	        commitment.element,
366	        commitment.lower,
367	        commitment.upper,
368	        commitment.prime,
369	        commitment.generator,
370	        commitment.h,
371	    )
372	    items = [_RANGE_DOMAIN]
373	    items.extend(str(field).encode("ascii") for field in fields)
374	    items.append(context)
375	    items.append(str(size).encode("ascii"))
376	    items.extend(str(t).encode("ascii") for t in announcements)
377	    transcript = hashlib.sha256()
378	    for item in items:
379	        transcript.update(len(item).to_bytes(4, "big"))
380	        transcript.update(item)
381	    return int.from_bytes(transcript.digest(), "big") % commitment.prime
382	
383	
384	def _check_commitment_fields(commitment: PedersenCommitment) -> None:
385	    for name in ("element", "lower", "upper", "prime", "generator", "h"):
386	        _check_int(getattr(commitment, name), f"commitment {name}")
387	
388	
389	def prove_range(
390	    commitment: PedersenCommitment,
391	    value: int,
392	    blinding: int,
393	    context: bytes = b"",
394	    *,
395	    randbelow: Callable[[int], int] = secrets.randbelow,
396	) -> RangeProof:
397	    """Prove that ``commitment`` opens at some value inside its declared range.
398	
399	    ``value`` and ``blinding`` must be a valid opening of ``commitment``;
400	    the opening is verified before any proving work happens and a mismatch
401	    raises :class:`ValueError`. The declared range may contain at most 256
402	    integers; wider ranges raise :class:`ValueError`. Randomness is drawn
403	    from ``randbelow`` (default :func:`secrets.randbelow`); a draw that is
404	    not a non-bool integer raises :class:`TypeError`, an out-of-range draw
405	    raises :class:`ValueError`.
406	    """
407	    if not isinstance(commitment, PedersenCommitment):
408	        raise TypeError("commitment must be a PedersenCommitment")
409	    _check_commitment_fields(commitment)
410	    _check_int(value, "value")
411	    _check_int(blinding, "blinding")
412	    _check_bytes(context, "context")
413	    if not callable(randbelow):
414	        raise TypeError("randbelow must be callable")
415	    size = commitment.upper - commitment.lower + 1
416	    if size > _MAX_RANGE_VALUES:
417	        raise ValueError(
418	            f"range must contain at most {_MAX_RANGE_VALUES} integers"
419	        )
420	    if not verify_pedersen_opening(commitment, value, blinding):
421	        raise ValueError("commitment does not open at (value, blinding)")
422	    prime = commitment.prime
423	    generator = commitment.generator
424	    h = commitment.h
425	
426	    def draw(upper: int) -> int:
427	        drawn = randbelow(upper)
428	        _check_int(drawn, "randbelow return value")
429	        if not 0 <= drawn < upper:
430	            raise ValueError(f"randbelow must return a value in [0, {upper})")
431	        return drawn
432	
433	    index = value - commitment.lower
434	    offsets = [commitment.element * pow(generator, -i, prime) % prime for i in range(size)]
435	    t: list[int] = [0] * size
436	    e: list[int] = [0] * size
437	    s: list[int] = [0] * size
438	    for i in range(size):
439	        if i == index:
440	            continue
441	        e[i] = draw(prime)  # challenge share in [0, prime)
442	        s[i] = draw(prime - 1) + 1  # non-negative response
443	        t[i] = pow(h, s[i], prime) * pow(offsets[i], -e[i], prime) % prime
444	    k = draw(prime - 1) + 1
445	    t[index] = pow(h, k, prime)
446	    challenge = _range_challenge(commitment, context, size, tuple(t))
447	    e[index] = (challenge - sum(e)) % prime
448	    s[index] = k + e[index] * blinding
449	    return RangeProof(t=tuple(t), e=tuple(e), s=tuple(s))
450	
451	
452	def verify_range(
453	    commitment: PedersenCommitment,
454	    proof: RangeProof,
455	    context: bytes = b"",
456	) -> bool:
457	    """Verify a :class:`RangeProof` against ``commitment`` and ``context``.
458	
459	    Every branch must satisfy the Schnorr equation
460	    ``h**s_i == t_i * D_i**e_i (mod prime)`` with
461	    ``D_i = element * generator**(-i) mod prime``, the challenge shares must
462	    lie in ``[0, prime)`` and sum to the transcript challenge modulo
463	    ``prime``, and the responses must be non-negative. Type errors (wrong
464	    object, non-tuple or non-integer proof fields, non-bytes context) raise
465	    :class:`TypeError`; any other invalid structure, tampering or binding
466	    mismatch — including ranges wider than 256 integers — returns ``False``.
467	    Inputs are never mutated.
468	    """
469	    if not isinstance(commitment, PedersenCommitment):
470	        raise TypeError("commitment must be a PedersenCommitment")
471	    _check_commitment_fields(commitment)
472	    if not isinstance(proof, RangeProof):
473	        raise TypeError("proof must be a RangeProof")
474	    for field_name in ("t", "e", "s"):
475	        field = getattr(proof, field_name)
476	        if not isinstance(field, tuple):
477	            raise TypeError(f"proof {field_name} must be a tuple of integers")
478	        for item in field:
479	            _check_int(item, f"proof {field_name} entry")
480	    _check_bytes(context, "context")
481	    prime = commitment.prime
482	    if prime <= 3:
483	        return False
484	    if not 1 < commitment.generator < prime or not 1 < commitment.h < prime:
485	        return False
486	    if not 0 < commitment.element < prime:
487	        return False
488	    if commitment.lower > commitment.upper:
489	        return False
490	    if commitment.upper - commitment.lower >= prime - 1:
491	        return False
492	    size = commitment.upper - commitment.lower + 1
493	    if size > _MAX_RANGE_VALUES:
494	        return False
495	    if not (len(proof.t) == len(proof.e) == len(proof.s) == size):
496	        return False
497	    if any(not 1 <= t_i < prime for t_i in proof.t):
498	        return False
499	    if any(not 0 <= e_i < prime for e_i in proof.e):
500	        return False
501	    if any(s_i < 0 for s_i in proof.s):
502	        return False
503	    challenge = _range_challenge(commitment, context, size, proof.t)
504	    if sum(proof.e) % prime != challenge:
505	        return False
506	    generator = commitment.generator
507	    h = commitment.h
508	    try:
509	        inverses = [pow(generator, -i, prime) for i in range(size)]
510	    except ValueError:
511	        return False  # generator not invertible modulo prime
512	    for i in range(size):
513	        offset = commitment.element * inverses[i] % prime
514	        left = pow(h, proof.s[i], prime)
515	        right = proof.t[i] * pow(offset, proof.e[i], prime) % prime
516	        if left != right:
517	            return False
518	    return True

521	@dataclass(frozen=True)
522	class RangeBatchEntry:
523	    """One item of a range batch verification.
524	
525	    Fields are the :class:`PedersenCommitment`, the :class:`RangeProof` and
526	    the ``context`` (empty by default) — exactly the arguments of
527	    :func:`verify_range`, in the same order.
528	    """
529	
530	    commitment: PedersenCommitment
531	    proof: RangeProof
532	    context: bytes = b""
533	
534	
535	def verify_range_batch(
536	    entries: Sequence[RangeBatchEntry],
537	    *,
538	    randbelow: Callable[[int], int] = secrets.randbelow,
539	) -> bool:
540	    """Verify a batch of :class:`RangeProof` objects with random linear checks.
541	
542	    ``entries`` must be a non-empty, non-string sequence of
543	    :class:`RangeBatchEntry`; an empty batch returns ``False`` and
544	    duplicate entries are legal (each draws its own coefficients). Every
545	    entry reuses the established :class:`RangeProof` transcript byte for
546	    byte, binding the six commitment fields, the declared range and the
547	    ``context``: the proof structure and tuple sizes must match, the
548	    ``t`` / ``e`` / ``s`` values must be in range, and the challenge
549	    shares must sum to the transcript challenge.
550	
551	    Each range-proof branch then draws exactly one random coefficient
552	    ``a = r + 1`` with ``r = randbelow(prime - 1)``. Branches sharing the
553	    same ``(prime, generator, h)`` group are checked together with a
554	    single aggregate equation
555	
556	    ``h**Σ(a*s) == Π(t**a * D_i**(a*e)) (mod prime)``
557	
558	    where ``D_i = element * generator**(-i) mod prime`` is unchanged from
559	    :func:`verify_range`; per-branch results are never AND-ed together.
560	    Type errors — including ``bool`` integers and a non-callable
561	    ``randbelow`` or one that returns a non-integer — raise
562	    :class:`TypeError`; a coefficient outside ``[0, prime - 1)`` raises
563	    :class:`ValueError`. Every other invalid structure, tampering,
564	    commitment or context binding mismatch returns ``False``;
565	    short-circuiting is allowed. Missing entries cannot be detected: the
566	    caller guarantees the batch is complete. Inputs are never mutated.
567	    """
568	    if isinstance(entries, (bytes, bytearray, str)) or not isinstance(entries, Sequence):
569	        raise TypeError("entries must be a sequence of RangeBatchEntry")
570	    if not callable(randbelow):
571	        raise TypeError("randbelow must be callable")
572	    items = list(entries)  # copy: inputs are never mutated
573	    if not items:
574	        return False
575	
576	    # group -> {"sum": Σ(a*s), "product": Π(t**a * D_i**(a*e))}
577	    groups: dict[tuple[int, int, int], dict[str, int]] = {}
578	
579	    def add_branch(
580	        group_key: tuple[int, int, int],
581	        t_i: int,
582	        e_i: int,
583	        s_i: int,
584	        offset_i: int,
585	    ) -> None:
586	        prime, _generator, _h = group_key
587	        r = randbelow(prime - 1)
588	        if not isinstance(r, int) or isinstance(r, bool):
589	            raise TypeError("coefficient source randbelow must return an integer")
590	        if not 0 <= r < prime - 1:
591	            raise ValueError("coefficient source must satisfy 0 <= r < prime - 1")
592	        coefficient = r + 1
593	        state = groups.setdefault(group_key, {"sum": 0, "product": 1})
594	        state["sum"] += coefficient * s_i
595	        state["product"] = (
596	            state["product"]
597	            * pow(t_i, coefficient, prime)
598	            % prime
599	            * pow(offset_i, coefficient * e_i, prime)
600	            % prime
601	        )
602	
603	    for position, entry in enumerate(items):
604	        if not isinstance(entry, RangeBatchEntry):
605	            raise TypeError(f"entries[{position}] must be a RangeBatchEntry")
606	        commitment = entry.commitment
607	        proof = entry.proof
608	        if not isinstance(commitment, PedersenCommitment):
609	            raise TypeError(f"entries[{position}] commitment must be a PedersenCommitment")
610	        _check_commitment_fields(commitment)
611	        if not isinstance(proof, RangeProof):
612	            raise TypeError(f"entries[{position}] proof must be a RangeProof")
613	        for field_name in ("t", "e", "s"):
614	            field = getattr(proof, field_name)
615	            if not isinstance(field, tuple):
616	                raise TypeError(
617	                    f"entries[{position}] proof {field_name} must be a tuple of integers"
618	                )
619	            for item in field:
620	                _check_int(item, f"entries[{position}] proof {field_name} entry")
621	        _check_bytes(entry.context, f"entries[{position}] context")
622	        try:
623	            prime, generator, h, size, announcements, shares, responses = (
624	                _range_proof_check_material(commitment, proof, entry.context)
625	            )
626	            inverses = [pow(generator, -i, prime) for i in range(size)]
627	        except (TypeError, ValueError):
628	            return False  # structural/transcript mismatch: short-circuit
629	        group_key = (prime, generator, h)
630	        for i in range(size):
631	            offset_i = commitment.element * inverses[i] % prime
632	            add_branch(
633	                group_key,
634	                announcements[i],
635	                shares[i],
636	                responses[i],
637	                offset_i,
638	            )
639	
640	    for (prime, _generator, _h), state in groups.items():
641	        if pow(_h, state["sum"], prime) != state["product"]:
642	            return False
643	    return True

646	class SchnorrProver:
647	    """Interactive Schnorr prover over a multiplicative group."""
648	
649	    def __init__(
650	        self,
651	        secret: int,
652	        *,
653	        prime: int = DEFAULT_PRIME,
654	        generator: int = DEFAULT_GENERATOR,
655	        randbelow: Callable[[int], int] = secrets.randbelow,
656	    ) -> None:
657	        if not isinstance(secret, int):
658	            raise TypeError("secret must be an integer")
659	        if not 0 < secret < prime:
660	            raise ValueError("secret must satisfy 0 < secret < prime")
661	        if not 1 < generator < prime:
662	            raise ValueError("generator must satisfy 1 < generator < prime")
663	        self._secret = secret
664	        self._prime = prime
665	        self._generator = generator

804	            challenge = _fs_challenge(
805	                self._prime,
806	                self._generator,
807	                self._public_key,
808	                proof.commitment,

829	    entries: Sequence[MultiSchnorrEntry],

833	    """Verify a batch of Fiat-Shamir proofs, potentially under several keys.
834

836	    :class:`MultiSchnorrEntry` carries its own ``public_key`` and group
837	    parameters, so a single batch may span several signers. ``entries``
838	    must be a non-empty, non-string sequence of :class:`MultiSchnorrEntry`;
839	    an empty batch returns ``False`` and duplicate entries are legal (each
840	    draws its own coefficient). Every entry reuses the established
841	    :class:`SchnorrProof` Fiat-Shamir transcript byte for byte, recomputing
842	    its challenge and thereby binding all six entry fields: ``public_key``,
843	    ``message``, ``proof``, ``context``, ``prime`` and ``generator``.
844	
845	    Each structurally valid entry draws exactly one random coefficient
846	    ``a = r + 1`` with ``r = randbelow(prime - 1)``. Entries sharing the
847	    same ``(prime, generator)`` group are checked together with a single
848	    aggregate equation
849	
850	    ``g**Σ(a*s) == Π(t**a * public_key**(a*c)) (mod prime)``
851	
852	    with each entry contributing under its own ``public_key``; per-entry
853	    results are never AND-ed together, and errors cannot cancel across
854	    different groups. Type errors — including ``bool`` integers and a
855	    non-callable ``randbelow`` or one that returns a non-integer — raise
856	    :class:`TypeError`; a coefficient outside ``[0, prime - 1)`` raises
857	    :class:`ValueError`. Every other invalid structure, tampering or
858	    binding mismatch returns ``False``; short-circuiting is allowed.
859	    Missing entries cannot be detected: the caller guarantees the batch
860	    is complete. Inputs are never mutated.
861	    """
862	    if isinstance(entries, (bytes, bytearray, str)) or not isinstance(entries, Sequence):
863	        raise TypeError("entries must be a sequence of MultiSchnorrEntry")
864	    if not callable(randbelow):
865	        raise TypeError("randbelow must be callable")
866	    items = list(entries)  # copy: inputs are never mutated
867	    if not items:
868	        return False
869	
870	    # (prime, generator) -> {"sum": Σ(a*s), "product": Π(t**a * y**(a*c))}
871	    groups: dict[tuple[int, int], dict[str, int]] = {}
872	
873	    for position, entry in enumerate(items):
874	        if not isinstance(entry, MultiSchnorrEntry):
875	            raise TypeError(f"entries[{position}] must be a MultiSchnorrEntry")
876	        _check_int(entry.public_key, f"entries[{position}] public_key")
877	        _check_bytes(entry.message, f"entries[{position}] message")
878	        proof = entry.proof
879	        if not isinstance(proof, SchnorrProof):
880	            raise TypeError(f"entries[{position}] proof must be a SchnorrProof")
881	        if (
882	            not isinstance(proof.commitment, int)
883	            or isinstance(proof.commitment, bool)
884	            or not isinstance(proof.response, int)
885	            or isinstance(proof.response, bool)
886	        ):
887	            raise TypeError(
888	                f"entries[{position}] proof commitment and response must be integers"
889	            )
890	        _check_bytes(entry.context, f"entries[{position}] context")
891	        _check_int(entry.prime, f"entries[{position}] prime")
892	        _check_int(entry.generator, f"entries[{position}] generator")
893	        prime = entry.prime
894	        generator = entry.generator
895	        if prime <= 3 or not 1 < generator < prime:
896	            return False
897	        if not 0 < entry.public_key < prime:
898	            return False
899	        if not 1 <= proof.commitment < prime or proof.response < 0:
900	            return False  # structurally invalid proof: short-circuit
901	        challenge = _fs_challenge(
902	            prime,
903	            generator,
904	            entry.public_key,
905	            proof.commitment,
906	            entry.context,
907	            entry.message,
908	        )
909	        r = randbelow(prime - 1)
910	        if not isinstance(r, int) or isinstance(r, bool):
911	            raise TypeError("coefficient source randbelow must return an integer")
912	        if not 0 <= r < prime - 1:
913	            raise ValueError("coefficient source must satisfy 0 <= r < prime - 1")
914	        coefficient = r + 1
915	        state = groups.setdefault((prime, generator), {"sum": 0, "product": 1})
916	        state["sum"] += coefficient * proof.response
917	        state["product"] = (
918	            state["product"]
919	            * pow(proof.commitment, coefficient, prime)
920	            % prime
921	            * pow(entry.public_key, coefficient * challenge, prime)
922	            % prime
923	        )
924	
925	    for (prime, generator), state in groups.items():
926	        if pow(generator, state["sum"], prime) != state["product"]:
927	            return False
928	    return True

993	def _region_sub_context(
994	    axis: bytes,
995	    context: bytes,
996	    region: Region,
997	    x_commitment: PedersenCommitment,
998	    y_commitment: PedersenCommitment,
999	) -> bytes:
1000	    """Length-prefixed transcript context for one axis sub-proof.
1001	
1002	    Items, in order: the region domain separator, the axis label, the
1003	    external context, the four region bounds and the six fields of the x
1004	    then the y commitment (dataclass field order). Every item is prefixed
1005	    with its four-byte unsigned big-endian length; integers are encoded as
1006	    decimal ASCII.

1008	    items = [_REGION_DOMAIN, axis, context]

1010	        str(bound).encode("ascii")
1011	        for bound in (region.min_x, region.max_x, region.min_y, region.max_y)
1012	    )
1013	    for commitment in (x_commitment, y_commitment):

1015	            str(getattr(commitment, name)).encode("ascii")
1016	            for name in ("element", "lower", "upper", "prime", "generator", "h")
1017	        )
1018	    transcript = bytearray()
1019	    for item in items:
1020	        transcript += len(item).to_bytes(4, "big")
1021	        transcript += item
1022	    return bytes(transcript)

1149	def _range_proof_check_material(
1150	    commitment: PedersenCommitment,
1151	    proof: RangeProof,
1152	    context: bytes,
1153	) -> tuple[int, int, int, int, tuple[int, ...], tuple[int, ...], tuple[int, ...]]:
1154	    """Validate one range proof structurally and return its batch material.
1155	
1156	    This mirrors :func:`verify_range` up to (but excluding) the per-branch
1157	    Schnorr equations: group parameters, ranges, tuple lengths, the
1158	    ``t`` / ``e`` / ``s`` bounds and the challenge sum are all checked
1159	    against the byte-for-byte transcript. The returned tuple is
1160	    ``(prime, generator, h, size, t, e, s)``; ``D_i`` is recomputed by the
1161	    caller as ``element * generator**(-i) mod prime``.
1162	    """
1163	    prime = commitment.prime
1164	    generator = commitment.generator
1165	    h = commitment.h
1166	    if prime <= 3 or not 1 < generator < prime or not 1 < h < prime:
1167	        raise ValueError("invalid commitment group parameters")
1168	    if not 0 < commitment.element < prime:
1169	        raise ValueError("commitment element out of range")
1170	    if commitment.lower > commitment.upper:
1171	        raise ValueError("commitment lower must not exceed upper")
1172	    if commitment.upper - commitment.lower >= prime - 1:
1173	        raise ValueError("commitment range width must be smaller than prime - 1")
1174	    size = commitment.upper - commitment.lower + 1
1175	    if size > _MAX_RANGE_VALUES:
1176	        raise ValueError(f"range must contain at most {_MAX_RANGE_VALUES} integers")
1177	    if not (len(proof.t) == len(proof.e) == len(proof.s) == size):
1178	        raise ValueError("proof fields must have one entry per integer in the range")
1179	    if any(not 1 <= t_i < prime for t_i in proof.t):
1180	        raise ValueError("proof announcement out of range")
1181	    if any(not 0 <= e_i < prime for e_i in proof.e):
1182	        raise ValueError("proof challenge share out of range")
1183	    if any(s_i < 0 for s_i in proof.s):
1184	        raise ValueError("proof response must be non-negative")
1185	    challenge = _range_challenge(commitment, context, size, proof.t)
1186	    if sum(proof.e) % prime != challenge:
1187	        raise ValueError("proof challenge shares do not sum to the transcript challenge")

1194	    randbelow: Callable[[int], int] = secrets.randbelow,
1195	) -> bool:
1196	    """Verify a batch of :class:`RegionProof` objects with random linear checks.
1197	
1198	    ``entries`` must be a non-empty, non-string sequence of
1199	    :class:`RegionBatchEntry`; an empty batch returns ``False`` and
1200	    duplicate entries are legal (each draws its own coefficients). Every
1201	    entry is validated exactly as :func:`verify_region` would, reusing the
1202	    established :class:`Region` and :class:`RangeProof` transcripts
1203	    byte for byte: the commitment ranges must equal the region bounds, the
1204	    sub-proof structure and tuple sizes must match, the ``t`` / ``e`` /
1205	    ``s`` values must be in range, and the challenge shares must sum to
1206	    the transcript challenge.
1207	
1208	    Each range-proof branch then draws exactly one random coefficient
1209	    ``a = r + 1`` with ``r = randbelow(prime - 1)``. Branches sharing the
1210	    same ``(prime, generator, h)`` group are checked together with a
1211	    single aggregate equation
1212	
1213	    ``h**Σ(a*s) == Π(t**a * D_i**(a*e)) (mod prime)``
1214	
1215	    where ``D_i = element * generator**(-i) mod prime`` is unchanged from
1216	    :func:`verify_range`; per-branch results are never AND-ed together.
1217	    Type errors — including ``bool`` integers and a non-callable
1218	    ``randbelow`` or one that returns a non-integer — raise
1219	    :class:`TypeError`; a coefficient outside ``[0, prime - 1)`` raises
1220	    :class:`ValueError`. Every other invalid structure, tampering, region,
1221	    commitment or context binding mismatch, cross-item recombination or
1222	    sub-proof count error returns ``False``; short-circuiting is allowed.
1223	    Missing entries cannot be detected: the caller guarantees the batch
1224	    is complete. Inputs are never mutated.
1225	    """
1226	    if isinstance(entries, (bytes, bytearray, str)) or not isinstance(entries, Sequence):
1227	        raise TypeError("entries must be a sequence of RegionBatchEntry")
1228	    if not callable(randbelow):
1229	        raise TypeError("randbelow must be callable")
1230	    items = list(entries)  # copy: inputs are never mutated
1231	    if not items:
1232	        return False
1233	
1234	    # group -> {"sum": Σ(a*s), "product": Π(t**a * D_i**(a*e))}
1235	    groups: dict[tuple[int, int, int], dict[str, int]] = {}
1236	
1237	    def add_branch(
1238	        group_key: tuple[int, int, int],
1239	        t_i: int,
1240	        e_i: int,
1241	        s_i: int,
1242	        offset_i: int,
1243	    ) -> None:
1244	        prime, _generator, _h = group_key
1245	        r = randbelow(prime - 1)
1246	        if not isinstance(r, int) or isinstance(r, bool):
1247	            raise TypeError("coefficient source randbelow must return an integer")
1248	        if not 0 <= r < prime - 1:
1249	            raise ValueError("coefficient source must satisfy 0 <= r < prime - 1")
1250	        coefficient = r + 1
1251	        state = groups.setdefault(group_key, {"sum": 0, "product": 1})
1252	        state["sum"] += coefficient * s_i
1253	        state["product"] = (
1254	            state["product"]
1255	            * pow(t_i, coefficient, prime)
1256	            % prime
1257	            * pow(offset_i, coefficient * e_i, prime)
1258	            % prime
1259	        )
1260	
1261	    for position, entry in enumerate(items):
1262	        if not isinstance(entry, RegionBatchEntry):
1263	            raise TypeError(f"entries[{position}] must be a RegionBatchEntry")
1264	        x_commitment = entry.x_commitment
1265	        y_commitment = entry.y_commitment
1266	        region = entry.region
1267	        proof = entry.proof
1268	        if not isinstance(x_commitment, PedersenCommitment):
1269	            raise TypeError(f"entries[{position}] x_commitment must be a PedersenCommitment")
1270	        if not isinstance(y_commitment, PedersenCommitment):
1271	            raise TypeError(f"entries[{position}] y_commitment must be a PedersenCommitment")
1272	        _check_commitment_fields(x_commitment)
1273	        _check_commitment_fields(y_commitment)
1274	        if not isinstance(region, Region):
1275	            raise TypeError(f"entries[{position}] region must be a Region")
1276	        _check_region_fields(region)
1277	        if not isinstance(proof, RegionProof):
1278	            raise TypeError(f"entries[{position}] proof must be a RegionProof")
1279	        if not isinstance(proof.x_proof, RangeProof):
1280	            raise TypeError(f"entries[{position}] proof x_proof must be a RangeProof")
1281	        if not isinstance(proof.y_proof, RangeProof):
1282	            raise TypeError(f"entries[{position}] proof y_proof must be a RangeProof")
1283	        for axis_name, sub_proof in (("x", proof.x_proof), ("y", proof.y_proof)):
1284	            for field_name in ("t", "e", "s"):
1285	                field = getattr(sub_proof, field_name)
1286	                if not isinstance(field, tuple):
1287	                    raise TypeError(
1288	                        f"entries[{position}] {axis_name}_proof {field_name} "
1289	                        "must be a tuple of integers"
1290	                    )
1291	                for item in field:
1292	                    _check_int(
1293	                        item,
1294	                        f"entries[{position}] {axis_name}_proof {field_name} entry",
1295	                    )
1296	        _check_bytes(entry.context, f"entries[{position}] context")
1297	        if (x_commitment.lower, x_commitment.upper) != (region.min_x, region.max_x):
1298	            return False
1299	        if (y_commitment.lower, y_commitment.upper) != (region.min_y, region.max_y):
1300	            return False
1301	        axes = (
1302	            (
1303	                b"x",
1304	                x_commitment,
1305	                proof.x_proof,
1306	                _region_sub_context(b"x", entry.context, region, x_commitment, y_commitment),
1307	            ),
1308	            (
1309	                b"y",
1310	                y_commitment,
1311	                proof.y_proof,
1312	                _region_sub_context(b"y", entry.context, region, x_commitment, y_commitment),
1313	            ),
1314	        )
1315	        for _axis, commitment, sub_proof, sub_context in axes:
1316	            try:
1317	                prime, generator, h, size, announcements, shares, responses = (
1318	                    _range_proof_check_material(commitment, sub_proof, sub_context)
1319	                )
1320	                inverses = [pow(generator, -i, prime) for i in range(size)]
1321	            except (TypeError, ValueError):
1322	                return False  # structural/transcript mismatch: short-circuit
1323	            group_key = (prime, generator, h)
1324	            for i in range(size):
1325	                offset_i = commitment.element * inverses[i] % prime
1326	                add_branch(
1327	                    group_key,
1328	                    announcements[i],
1329	                    shares[i],
1330	                    responses[i],
1331	                    offset_i,
1332	                )
1333	
1334	    for (prime, generator, h), state in groups.items():
1335	        if pow(h, state["sum"], prime) != state["product"]:
1336	            return False
1337	    return True
